messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty Alert fired: PD-4321 (sev: P1) - gpu-pool-3 - cuda::out_of_memory

pagerduty: Auto-page: PD-4321 -> oncall schedule (primary: emma)

emma: Acked. I'm on it. Checking runbook and metrics now. Anyone seeing customer-facing 5xx spikes?

raj: Not yet on the SLO dashboard, but k8s events show repeated OOM on gpu-node-47 and gpu-node-52. Logs show `cublasAlloc failed` and `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation`.

marta: I've got a tail of the allocator logs, looks like kvcache prefetch is spiking mem usage. snippet:

`````
[2026-03-15T12:00:01Z] alloc: attempt to allocate 2.0GiB failed: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[2026-03-15T12:00:02Z] kvcache: prefetch_batch=64 active=1024 estimated_kv_size=1.9GiB
[2026-03-15T12:00:02Z] model-loader: variant=v2-large embeddings=1.2G entries
`````

sam: Confirmed. We're seeing an autopager noise pattern: lots of transient alloc fails from short-lived jobs. PD dedupe suppressed earlier but this burst slides past the suppression window -> noisy pages.

emma: Quick mitigation plan: 1) disable kvcache prefetch on gpu-pool-3, 2) scale down batch size for runners, 3) enable fallback routing to cpu-model for low-priority traffic. I'm applying step 1 now.

marta: Command to toggle prefetch:

`````
kubectl -n inference patch configmap gpu-serving-config --patch '{"data":{"kvcache_prefetch":"false"}}'
# then rollout restart deployment/gpu-runtime -n inference
`````

raj: I'll watch node pressure and coordinator logs. Also opening a temporary throttling rule in the autoscaler to shed best-effort queues.

pagerduty: PD note: PD-4321 acknowledged by emma at 12:03 UTC.

emma: Patch applied, restarted gpu-runtime pods. Observing eviction/restart stream slowing.

sam: Quick metrics: OOM events/min down from 28 -> 4 over the last 2m. Token-serving p50 latency unchanged, p95 improved ~10%. Customer 5xx rate down from 0.8% -> 0.2%.

marta: Rolling a hotfix branch to reduce kvcache prefetch window size as a medium-term fix. Will open PR with perf tests; won't merge to prod without validation.

emma: Handoff: raj, can you take the rest of the watch and keep PD updated? I'll write initial incident notes.

raj: Taking handoff. Keeping an eye for reoccurrence and coordinating with infra to provision a temporary spare GPU node if pressure increases. ETA 15m to validate.

pagerduty: PD note: Escalation suppressed; oncall holding.

sam: Post-incident observation: probable trigger was a newly deployed model variant with larger embedding tables in combination with aggressive kvcache prefetch. Recommend: gate prefetch per model size, add memory-safety checks in the allocator, and add backpressure signal to the prefetcher.

emma: Customer impact: small cohort of low-volume customers saw transient 5xx between 12:00-12:06 UTC. No enterprise SLAs affected. Filing incident ticket INC-2026-0315 and assigning to eng-runtime.

raj: I'll attach the current logs and the kvcache metrics export to the ticket. If it resurges, escalate to infra oncall @peter for spare node provisioning.

peter: (pinged) I'm standing by. I can bring up a spare GPU node in ~10m if you ask.

incident-bot: Thread placed into monitoring-only mode by emma. Actions recorded: follow-up postmortem, default kvcache_prefetch -> false, mem-safety allocator checks RFC.

emma: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
